ios.desc:
Lola’s Alphabet Train – A fun and easy letter game for kids

Completely free, no ads, no purchases.  Just learning and joy!

Alphabet Train is our very first and most popular early reading app. It is designed for children who are starting from the very beginning: learning letters and getting familiar with the alphabet. The goal is to make the first steps toward reading fun, light, and safe.

Welcome aboard Lola’s Alphabet Train!

This app is completely free with no external ads or in-app purchases. Your child can focus 100% on learning and fun activities.

Lola’s Alphabet Train is suitable for children aged 3–7 who are learning letters, recognizing their first words, and taking their first steps into reading. The game progresses calmly and gently, with cheerful Finnish voice guidance.

What does Lola’s Alphabet Train teach?

The app helps your child:
• recognize letters and the alphabet
• practice uppercase and lowercase letters
• match letters with pictures
• develop auditory perception
• take the first steps toward reading

Each activity supports early literacy in a fun and engaging way, either independently or with a parent.

What makes Alphabet Train special?
• No in-app purchases
• Easy to understand and use
• A happy, safe world where Lola guides the learning
• Lots of repetition and visual hints
• No external advertising – only Lola’s learning world behind a parental lock
• Great for home use or early education

Included in the game:
• letter recognition games
• alphabet order practice
• simple controls (choose or drag your answer)
• memory games
• letter-to-word matching
• animated rewards and encouraging feedback

When your child is ready for the next step

If your child wants to learn more, we recommend Lola's Learningland – a complete modern reading app that covers the whole learning journey from letters to advanced words.

In Learningland, children learn:
• sounds and letters
• syllable recognition
• reading easy, medium, and difficult words
… and much more.

For parents
The app was developed with teachers and early childhood education professionals. It supports early literacy by offering:
• a clear and safe environment
• repetition and step-by-step progression
• positive encouragement and a sense of success
• a learning environment without pressure or competition

The app works on iPhone and iPad.

Enjoy learning in Lola’s Alphabet Train. All aboard!
A fun and easy alphabet game for young readers.

quotes.text:
Is anyone willing to share the resources they strongly recommend after use in their childhood and/or with their own children? The recent discussion of children's author Sandra Boynton inspired this attempt to broaden the discussion to any similarly excellent tools. I am most specifically interested in recommendations related to learning foreign languages.

I have personally used and strongly recommend:

· Baby Signing Time http://store.signingtime.com/baby-signing-time DVD

· The Best of the Laurie Berkner Band https://amzn.com/dp/B003SJVM5M as a music CD for the car.

· Lola's Alphabet Train https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/lolas-alphabet-train-free-learn-to-read/id428422381?mt=8

· KidsTV123 https://www.youtube.com/user/KidsTV123

· Word Party https://www.netflix.com/title/80063705

Based on a strong personal recommendation of a relative, I am looking forward to soon using:

· Teach Your Child to Read in 100 Easy Lessons https://amzn.com/dp/0671631985
